'''Darrok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was the one who received the location of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] deserter [[Cipher Three]], father of [[Raina Temple]]. Temple intercepted the message and knowing that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] punishment could be worse than [[Death/Legends|death]], killed her father herself.
